title: Arsenal Chaos
description: This mod adds two new yet destructive weapons to the game - the big bonk hammer that literally summons meteors, and the doomslayer sword that bombards the surroundings with slashes
body:
Arsenal Chaos

A minecraft mod made using fabric api (1.21 version of minecraft supported only) that adds two diabolical weapons to the game

1. A bonk hammer that lets the player summon literally meteors from the sky when player hits any mob with the hammer

2. The meteor will blow up everything in the vicinity of 10 blocks of the player and the player will be immune to it while using the bonk hammer

3. Also, when the player uses the bonk hammer once, he gains access to the doom slayer sword for 30 seconds and the sword will cause an explosion, damaging the mob getting hit by the sword through the explosion.

4. The doom slayer sword also has a signature move in which when player right clicks any mob, every mob near the player gets bombarded with sword sweep slashes along with the mob the player right clicks on.

5. There is a 5 minute cooldown after the doom slayer sword timer expires.

6. The meteor summoned by the big bonk hammer causes a massive explosion that even causes blocks to fly high up in the sky, imitating real world physics.
